utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely, and folks are already dropping off tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure it’s actually coming together? I just want to confirm before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I’ve heard around the block—nothing official, but it sounds like it’s really picking up steam.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ve been a bit out of the loop, so keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a quick list of what still needs fixing and any parts you’ve already got. I can swing by and help coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll make a quick list tonight and send it over. I’ve already got a few screws and a replacement hinge.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out, just tell me what still needs fixing for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we still need tape, a couple of screwdrivers, and some heavy-duty trash bags. If you can grab any of those, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can pick up the tape and heavy-duty trash bags. I’ll swing by later and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’m aiming for Saturday morning so folks can help before lunch. If that works with the school schedule, I’ll lock it in and send the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work well with the school schedule. Go ahead and lock it in, and I’ll help spread the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah right, the repair drive—I'm gathering the broken stuff first, then we'll sort what can be fixed. If you can help haul things over, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that. Tell me when and where to meet, and I’ll help haul the broken things over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive — want me to invite you to the next neighborhood update?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please invite me — I’d like the update, but I may need the details in advance so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details ahead of time and make sure you’re on the update list. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive from a couple of folks—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re still on track—I'm lining up volunteers and a few tools, and we should have the first round of fixes happening soon. If you know anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great—I'll ask around and pass along anyone who seems handy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can send you the repair drive details again. If you want, I can also help you double-check the time and drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please send the details again, and I’d like to double-check the time and drop-off list too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’m keeping it brief today. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the late shift and bring the spare tools. Just point me to whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — the late shift and spare tools cover a lot. If you can also check whether we still need any tape or extension cords, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if you need any tools for the repair drive, just let me know and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a drill and a set of screwdrivers I could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — you can borrow my drill and screwdriver set for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location—where should I head first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start at the community center bulletin board, then check the front desk if it’s not there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll check the community center bulletin board first, then the front desk if needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools if that helps with the repair drive—just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that once I know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course—just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that makes sense — can you confirm the timing and where we’re dropping things off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s keep it simple: I can do late morning, but I need the exact drop-off address and any parking instructions first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks together for the repair drive — I can check who’s available and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Jules—thank you. Please let me know who’s available, and I’ll help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and let you know who’s available. Thanks, Mara; with both of us spreading the word, this should go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep tabs on the repair supplies—what do you still need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late, but I can check what’s already been set aside and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush — just let me know what’s already set aside and I’ll track the gaps. I can help make sure we’re covered for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear, thanks Tess. I’ll keep an eye out for any school pickup conflicts while it’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye—much appreciated! I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything about the pickup timing or any changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in, just send me the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo — we’re meeting Saturday at 10 by the community garden. If you can, bring gloves, a hammer, and any spare tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Saturday at 10 by the community garden. I’ll bring gloves, a hammer, and a few extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and keep track of what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and keep a list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Want me to invite a few more neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — that would help a lot. I’m still catching up, so any extra neighbors you can invite would be great.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask a few more neighbors and get the word out right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive locations yet, Eli, but I can keep an eye on them if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Opal. Let’s keep it simple—just let me know when you spot the locations, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Eli—I’ll let you know as soon as I spot the locations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive already get a start date?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — let me know once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep my eyes open too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’m heading out now, so I’ll ask around and tell you if I hear anything.
